name: He Zheng
current_role: Director and General Manager, Shenzhen Wote Advanced Materials Co. (沃特股份, 002886.SZ)
profile: He Zheng (何征), born Feb 1971, is director and general manager of Shenzhen Wote Advanced Materials, a Shenzhen-listed specialty polymer/chemical materials maker chaired by Wu Xian (吴宪), with whom Hurun lists his wealth. A securities-data profile lists him holding ~35.1m shares (~13.3%).
interesting_fact: He is a senior engineer with an undergraduate degree from Harbin Engineering University.
notes: Facts from search-result snippets of lixinger.com (page itself blocked to direct fetch); current data may be dated. Chairman Wu Xian is the public face of the company.

name: Ma Yongtao
current_role: Controlling shareholder and actual controller of Guangdong Dongjian Technology (东箭科技, 300978.SZ); listed as chairman in 2023 filings
profile: Ma Yongtao (马永涛) is the controlling shareholder of Dongjian Technology, a Guangdong maker of automotive exterior parts, roof racks and vehicle protection systems that has expanded into outdoor gear and full-vehicle customization. 2023 filings show him holding ~25.3% directly plus stakes via Dongjian Huiying Investment.
interesting_fact: The company says its founder entered the car-modification industry in 1994, and in 2023 Ma bought more shares on market (823,500 shares).
notes: Hurun lists wealth shared with Liu Shaorong. A July 2026 report names Luo Jun as Dongjian chairman (and racing driver), so Ma may no longer be chairman; verify. Facts on holdings from 2023 company announcements (dongjian.cc PDFs) via search snippets.

name: Gao Nan
current_role: Legal representative and co-actual controller, Jiangsu Yunyong Electronics and Technology (云涌科技, 688060.SH)
profile: Gao Nan (高南) is legal representative and, with Jiao Fuwei, the actual controller of Jiangsu Yunyong Electronics, a Taizhou, Jiangsu company founded in 2010 and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market. It makes industrial information-security and industrial IoT products for power, energy, finance and rail customers.
interesting_fact: From its founding Yunyong built embedded platforms on PowerPC, ARM and MIPS with trimmed Linux, and was among the first in China to apply embedded tech to industrial-internet security.
notes: Company email listed in exchange-derived company profile; board secretary route. No personal biography found.

name: Li Zaichun
current_role: Co-founder and former controlling shareholder of Sichuan Haite High-Tech (海特高新, 002023.SZ); son Li Biao is chairman
profile: Li Zaichun (李再春), a senior engineer who spent 30+ years at a military aviation factory, co-founded Sichuan Haite High-Tech with his son Li Biao in 1991. Haite grew into a leading private aircraft MRO, avionics-testing and component-repair group listed in Shenzhen; Li was its actual controller in 2009-2011 filings and later transferred shares to Li Biao.
interesting_fact: Haite started in 1991 with an investment of just 10,000 yuan, attached to a state unit, doing aviation test equipment and airborne electronic component repair.
deep_cut_fact: As early as 1983 he moonlighted as a 'Sunday engineer'; in 1986 he co-launched the private Chengdu New Technology Application Institute, developing domestic replacements for aircraft VHF antennas, filters and boards.
notes: Likely elderly and retired; no recent public role found. Son Li Biao (shared Hurun entry) is the company's public face. Alive status not confirmed either way.

name: Zhou Shaoxiong
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Fujian Septwolves Industry Co. (七匹狼, 002029.SZ)
profile: Zhou Shaoxiong (周少雄) co-founded menswear brand Septwolves in Jinjiang, Fujian in 1990 with brothers Zhou Yongwei and Zhou Shaoming and Chen Pengling; the company listed in Shenzhen in 2004 and is now based in Xiamen. The three brothers are its actual controllers; Shaoxiong runs the listed apparel business, which bought the Karl Lagerfeld brand in 2017.
interesting_fact: His motto, echoing the brand name 'seven wolves': 'A lone wolf is easy to defeat; a united wolf pack is very hard to defeat.' (孤独的狼容易战胜，精诚团结的狼群，很难战胜)
deep_cut_fact: The three Zhou brothers all had stable jobs in the 1980s before choosing to go into business; Shaoxiong's lasting passion is apparel, so he runs the listed clothing company while his brothers handle the group's investments.
notes: Chaired Septwolves board meetings through June 2025; a board re-election occurred 8 July 2025 - confirm he was re-elected chairman. Jiemian article age at time of writing: 61.

name: Zhang Lilan
current_role: Founding shareholder, Chongqing Sifang New Material Co. (四方新材)
profile: Zhang Lilan (张理兰) is an early investor and founding shareholder of Chongqing Sifang New Material, a ready-mix concrete producer whose predecessor, Chongqing Sifang Concrete, was set up in 2003 by Li Dezhi, now its chairman and general manager. She and Li Dezhi funded a 2006 capital increase; Hurun lists their wealth jointly.
interesting_fact: She is listed in the company's articles of association as a promoter who subscribed 8 million shares, paid in on 31 March 2016.
notes: Low public profile; no current executive role found. Li Dezhi (chairman) is the company's public face.

name: Erik B Nordstrom
current_role: Chief Executive Officer, Nordstrom Inc. (privately held since May 2025)
profile: Erik Nordstrom, of the Seattle department-store family, has been sole CEO of Nordstrom since March 2020, after serving as co-president from 2015 and president of Nordstrom.com. He led the family's take-private with Mexico's El Puerto de Liverpool (family 50.1%/Liverpool 49.9%), announced Dec 2024; shares were delisted from the NYSE on 20 May 2025.
interesting_fact: The $6.25bn take-private was the family's second attempt; a 2018 buyout bid was rejected by the board.
deep_cut_fact: He started in 1976 working in the stockroom of Nordstrom's Seattle flagship, and from 1979 sold shoes in the shoe department through high school and college; he holds a business degree from UW's Foster School.
notes: Company now private; press via Nordstrom PR.
